message:
Apply the supplied Solve with Evidence skill in skill/SKILL.md. Use the ordinary shell when useful. The trusted receiver command for this job is ./case-check. It accepts JSON on stdin and reports its verdict. Treat it as an opaque tool. Do not inspect or modify its implementation or search for its tests. Write working files in the current directory. Put files for the user inside the outputs directory. The recipient resolves Markdown file links from the current directory and can open absolute local paths.

A message bridge calls frame(*, fields, sequence). Deliver standalone Python source defining that pure function. fields is a list of Unicode strings (possibly empty); sequence is a nonnegative integer. The function returns one string. The header is the ASCII decimal sequence, with no leading zeroes, followed by one raw vertical bar. For each field in order, append the ASCII decimal count of UTF-8 octets in its escaped text, a colon, the escaped text, and a raw semicolon. Append one actual carriage return and one actual line feed to terminate the frame, including when the list is empty. Never modify or normalize the inputs.

Escape original characters exactly once. Backslash maps to two backslashes; semicolon to backslash plus semicolon; carriage return to backslash plus lowercase r; line feed to backslash plus lowercase n. Pass all other characters through, including double quotes, colon, vertical bar and combining marks. Count bytes AFTER escaping, excluding the length prefix, colon and semicolon delimiter. The raw frame terminator is outside all fields. A literal backslash followed by r is different from a carriage return.

Return a JSON object with exactly "source", "sample", and "edge". "source" is your standalone function's complete decoded text (no I/O, no process access). "sample" is the exact frame string for the supplied job. "edge" is {"job":{"fields":[...],"sequence":N},"expected":"..."} with at most two fields each at most 24 Unicode characters, and N in 0..999. Choose an edge where the specific faulty bridge that counts Unicode characters of the escaped text, instead of UTF-8 octets, emits a different frame. Keep the required named job shape even if you only use one field.

Supplied job (JSON): {"fields": ["é", "水;🚲", "A\r\nB", "\\r", "\"", ""], "sequence": 41}

Deliver either the JSON object alone in your final answer, or one Markdown link to a downloadable file containing that JSON. The receiver will open the link if present. In both modes it evaluates the exact UTF-8 bytes it receives. A digest or code fence is not a deliverable.
